title: Set Up Your Project
description: Create a new Next.js app and add two pages: Home and About.
problemStatement:
## Goal You will create a brand new Next.js application and add a simple About page. ### Steps 1. Open your terminal and run `npx create-next-app@latest my-pages`. 2. Choose the default options (press Enter for all). 3. Navigate into the project folder: `cd my-pages`. 4. Create a new file: `pages/about.js`. 5. In `pages/about.js`, export a default function component that renders an `

About Page

` and a paragraph with some text. 6. In `pages/index.js`, modify the existing Home component to display an `

Welcome to the Home Page

` and a description. 7. Start the dev server with `npm run dev` and verify both pages load at `http://localhost:3000` and `http://localhost:3000/about`.
hints: Remember that any file placed inside the `pages/` folder automatically becomes a route.
You can write normal JSX in your components.
Check your terminal for any errors if a page doesn’t load.
expectedOutput: At `http://localhost:3000` you see "Welcome to the Home Page". At `http://localhost:3000/about` you see "About Page".
